messages:
Ivy Nguyen: hey all, quick onboarding question: I'm aligning who-to-ask for common day1/day2 hurdles — deploy rollbacks, VPC & vault entitlements, pager adds, and model catalog pins. can someone sketch who owns each lane?
Marcus Hale: welcome Ivy! short map: deploy rollbacks = eng-releases, VPC/vault entitlements = people-ops + infra for network bits, pager adds = eng-oncall, model-catalog pins = research/product review.
Ivy Nguyen: super helpful. for vault entitlements, do I file a people-ops ticket or an infra ticket?
Sofia Ramirez: file a people-ops request using the "Vault Entitlement" template; they kick off infra if subnet/network changes are needed. include project tag and repo access list.
Ivy Nguyen: got it. pager adds  any special fields the oncall team needs?
Ben Ito: yes  for PagerDuty add requests include SSO email, service tag (e.g., svc:realtime-router), role (primary/secondary), and a linked ticket approving it. send via infra board template "PagerDuty: add user".
Ivy Nguyen: nice. for deploy rollbacks, besides releases@, who should be looped in for customer-impact assessment?
Marcus Hale: releases@ + service owner + product-ops for customer comms. if rollback is due to infra, add eng-sre.
Ivy Nguyen: and model catalog pins  do I need a formal meeting or is PR + tag enough?
Sofia Ramirez: PR in model-catalog with changelog + evaluation summary. tag @research-review and @product-approvers. small patch pins can be fast-tracked; major model swaps need a sync.
Ivy Nguyen: last one  emergency access (ssh/db) during incidents, who signs off quickly?
Ben Ito: emergency access is approved by the oncall lead and recorded with people-ops for audit. file "Emergency Access" on infra board and mark P0 with timebox.
Ivy Nguyen: awesome, thanks. would love a tiny checklist I can bookmark.
OpsBot: automation: quick bookmark list: /oncall/escalation-ladder, /infra/templates, /people-ops/vault-requests, /model-catalog/guide.
Ivy Nguyen: thank you! I'll file the first tickets if anything blocks.
IT Support: note: for VPN/laptop asset provisioning, DM IT Support your asset tag ASAP to avoid VPN delays.
Ivy Nguyen: on it. appreciate the quick orientation everyone :wave:
